messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: status of Stan 2.4
parts:
Stan 2.4 is due out any day now. We hope to get it out this
week, but it might have to wait until next week.

It's been held up because

1. our continuous integration server's motherboard finally went belly
up after several years of being hammered and Daniel had to configure
a new server and manually prime the testing process, and

2. Daniel is in Cancun at ISBA giving a talk on Stan, and
he's been the one managing the builds and tests for releases.
(We should really spread that pain around; I did the first
few releases and it's not a lot of fun, despite how much of
the process we now have automated.)

The 2.4 release will have all sorts of goodies:

* patches all the reported problems with functions
* include vectorization of multi_normal
* cholesky factor for correlation matrix data type
* lkj_correlation_cholesky density
* L-BFGS optimization

and probably more (this is just what I recall off the
top of my head); the release notes will be complete.

- Bob

parts:
My models will fly with the vectorized multi-normal and that fix for rstan with pre-allocation we had earlier this week which is hopefully "in" for 2.4?

Looking very much forward to this release! But Cancun could delay it for good reasons I understand...

Best,
Sebastian
